name: Love on the Approach
source:
You are the new manager of a university women's volleyball team. Build deep relationships with the unique players through your choices, guiding them to victory on the court and exploring personal, mature connections off the court in this adult romantic visual novel. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4182690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是大学女排的新任经理。在这部成人浪漫视觉小说中，通过你的选择与独特的球员建立深厚的关系，引导他们在球场上取得胜利，并在球场外探索个人、成熟的联系。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4182690/]Steam[/url]]
